title: Safeguards regardless of DGA status

statement.en: Where an intermediation function exists, the rulebook shall provide the DGA safeguards (neutrality, non-discrimination, liability, remedies) and identify their legal basis: the DGA where it applies, otherwise contract or data space rules.

control: Rulebook clauses reviewed against the four safeguards; DGA status of each intermediation function assessed

expressions.note: Clauses and DGA assessment checked by people.

source: DSSC decision log D-17, D-25, O-06
